svg.title: Architectural proposal: actual IFC model
svg.desc: Three-storey RC frame with stairs, elevator shaft and shared wall. Floors and enclosing walls are transparent for visibility. Simulated review model.

g.text: Three-storey RC office · approximately 18 × 12 m · Taipei
Floors and enclosing walls are transparent to reveal the core. Colours identify parts.
Rendered from core-candidate.ifc · Simulated proposal · Design review remains open
